mapper.sql: (SELECT MAX(v.TERMS_VER) FROM TB_CO_TERMS v WHERE v.TERMS_CD = bt.TERMS_CD AND v.USE_YN = 'Y' AND v.EFFECT_DT <= #{baseDt})
mapper.select: SELECT bt.BIZ_CD, bt.REQ_YN, bt.SORT_ORD, bt.USE_YN AS MAP_USE_YN, t.TERMS_CD, t.TERMS_VER, t.TERMS_NM, t.PDF_URL, t.CN_HASH, t.EFFECT_DT, t.USE_YN FROM TB_CO_BIZ_TERMS bt JOIN TB_CO_TERMS t ON t.TERMS_CD = bt.TERMS_CD AND t.TERMS_VER = WHERE bt.BIZ_CD = #{bizCd} AND bt.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY bt.REQ_YN DESC, bt.SORT_ORD, bt.TERMS_CD
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CO_TERMS SET CN_HASH = #{cnHash} WHERE TERMS_CD = #{termsCd} AND TERMS_VER = #{termsVer} AND CN_HASH IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_TERMS_AGREE (BIZ_CD, CUST_ID, SESS_KEY, CHANNEL, CLIENT_IP, AGREE_AT) VALUES (#{bizCd}, #{custId}, #{sessKey}, #{channel}, #{clientIp}, #{agreeAt})
INSERT INTO TB_CO_TERMS_AGREE_DTL (AGREE_NO, TERMS_CD, TERMS_VER, CN_HASH, REQ_YN, AGREE_YN, VIEW_YN) VALUES (#{agreeNo}, #{termsCd}, #{termsVer}, #{cnHash}, #{reqYn}, #{agreeYn}, #{viewYn})
mapper.select: SELECT a.AGREE_NO, a.BIZ_CD, b.BIZ_NM, a.CUST_ID, a.SESS_KEY, a.CHANNEL, a.CLIENT_IP, a.AGREE_AT FROM TB_CO_TERMS_AGREE a LEFT JOIN TB_CO_TERMS_BIZ b ON b.BIZ_CD = a.BIZ_CD WHERE a.AGREE_NO = #{agreeNo}

SELECT d.AGREE_NO, d.TERMS_CD, t.TERMS_NM, d.TERMS_VER, d.CN_HASH, d.REQ_YN, d.AGREE_YN, d.VIEW_YN FROM TB_CO_TERMS_AGREE_DTL d LEFT JOIN TB_CO_TERMS t ON t.TERMS_CD = d.TERMS_CD AND t.TERMS_VER = d.TERMS_VER WHERE d.AGREE_NO = #{agreeNo} ORDER BY d.REQ_YN DESC, d.TERMS_CD

SELECT b.BIZ_CD, b.BIZ_NM, b.BIZ_DESC, b.USE_YN, b.REG_AT, b.REG_BY, b.UPD_AT, b.UPD_BY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CO_BIZ_TERMS x WHERE x.BIZ_CD = b.BIZ_CD AND x.USE_YN = 'Y' AND x.REQ_YN = 'Y') AS REQ_CNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CO_BIZ_TERMS x WHERE x.BIZ_CD = b.BIZ_CD AND x.USE_YN = 'Y' AND x.REQ_YN = 'N') AS OPT_CNT FROM TB_CO_TERMS_BIZ b ORDER BY b.REG_AT, b.BIZ_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_TERMS_BIZ (BIZ_CD, BIZ_NM, BIZ_DESC, USE_YN, REG_AT, REG_BY, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{bizCd}, #{bizNm}, #{bizDesc}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE BIZ_NM = VALUES(BIZ_NM), BIZ_DESC = VALUES(BIZ_DESC), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_AT = VALUES(UPD_AT), UPD_BY = VALUES(UPD_BY)
mapper.select: SELECT bt.BIZ_CD, bt.REQ_YN, bt.SORT_ORD, bt.USE_YN AS MAP_USE_YN, bt.TERMS_CD, t.TERMS_VER, t.TERMS_NM, t.EFFECT_DT, t.PDF_URL FROM TB_CO_BIZ_TERMS bt LEFT JOIN TB_CO_TERMS t ON t.TERMS_CD = bt.TERMS_CD AND t.TERMS_VER = WHERE bt.BIZ_CD = #{bizCd} ORDER BY bt.REQ_YN DESC, bt.SORT_ORD, bt.TERMS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_BIZ_TERMS (BIZ_CD, TERMS_CD, REQ_YN, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{bizCd}, #{termsCd}, #{reqYn}, #{sortOrd}, #{mapUseYn}, #{regAt}, #{regBy})
mapper.select: SELECT t.TERMS_CD, t.TERMS_VER, t.TERMS_NM, t.EFFECT_DT, t.USE_YN, t.REG_AT, t.REG_BY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CO_TERMS c WHERE c.TERMS_CD = t.TERMS_CD) AS VER_CNT, (SELECT MAX(c.TERMS_VER) FROM TB_CO_TERMS c WHERE c.TERMS_CD = t.TERMS_CD AND c.USE_YN = 'Y' AND c.EFFECT_DT <= #{baseDt}) AS CURRENT_VER FROM TB_CO_TERMS t WHERE t.TERMS_VER = (SELECT MAX(m.TERMS_VER) FROM TB_CO_TERMS m WHERE m.TERMS_CD = t.TERMS_CD) ORDER BY t.TERMS_CD
SELECT TERMS_CD, TERMS_VER, TERMS_NM, PDF_URL, CN_HASH, EFFECT_DT, USE_YN, REG_AT, REG_BY FROM TB_CO_TERMS WHERE TERMS_CD = #{termsCd} ORDER BY TERMS_VER DESC
SELECT TERMS_CD, TERMS_VER, TERMS_NM, EFFECT_DT FROM TB_CO_TERMS WHERE TERMS_CD = #{termsCd} ORDER BY TERMS_VER DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_TERMS (TERMS_CD, TERMS_VER, TERMS_NM, TERMS_CN, PDF_URL, CN_HASH, EFFECT_DT, USE_YN, REG_AT, REG_BY) VALUES (#{termsCd}, #{termsVer}, #{termsNm}, #{termsCn}, #{pdfUrl}, #{cnHash}, #{effectDt}, 'Y', #{regAt}, #{regBy})
